interpretation: With n = 3 the floor is the minimum of three draws; the bootstrap distribution is discrete and wide. The 95% CI spans up to the second-lowest replica, and there is a non-trivial probability that a re-drawn control trio would set the floor at or above 0.5 — i.e. candidate-vs-floor comparisons near the boundary are not stable, and per-replica differences within a ligand are not ranking evidence.
